profile_text.body:
ClickUp is a for-profit startup founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Diego, CA. The company describes its mission as making the world more productive, and it markets its core offering as an "everything app for work" combining tasks, docs, goals, and chat in a single platform.

ClickUp's AI product, called ClickUp AI, is categorized as a notes, knowledge, and meetings tool and is described as an all-in-one productivity AI covering document generation, task automation, and broad data access. The company also promotes a feature called Brain², which it describes as having real-time visibility into a user's tasks, documents, and conversations without requiring a separate brief. ClickUp is additionally present in the MCP server registry through a third-party server that supports managing workspaces by creating, updating, and organizing tasks, lists, folders, and tags.

The held facts note 161 California law exposure records associated with ClickUp, suggesting meaningful legal activity in that jurisdiction, though no specific litigation cases are recorded in the current data.
